summary: Pure Bioscience filed an 8-K reporting a private placement financing raising $1.0 million through the issuance of 18,131,096 shares at $0.0553 per share to accredited investors. Board members participated, and disinterested directors approved. Proceeds will fund general corporate purposes including R&D and working capital. This is a routine capital-raising transaction under Rule 506 of Regulation D, not a special situation. No change of control, tender offer, or strategic event is involved.
